purpose: Small, manually checked primary-source excerpts supporting STATUS.md; not an exhaustive literature search or novelty certificate.

records.source: Emil Wolf, Polarization invariance in beam propagation, Optics Letters 32, 3400-3401 (2007)
records.access: Primary publisher abstract read; full text inaccessible
records.quote: we derive sufficiency conditions for the degree of polarization of a beam generated by a uniformly polarized stochastic, electromagnetic source
records.scope: Abstract explicitly limits equality to the source plane and throughout the far zone. It does not claim a general necessary condition.

records.source: Jixiong Pu, Olga Korotkova and Emil Wolf, Invariance and noninvariance of the spectra of stochastic electromagnetic beams on propogation, Optics Letters 31, 2097-2099 (2006)
records.quote: When this law is satisfied the normalized spectrum of the beam is the same throughout the far zone and across the source.
records.scope: Electromagnetic planar secondary stochastic sources; sufficient scaling law.

records.source: XinHui Zhao et al., Condition for Gaussian Schell-model beam to maintain the state of polarization on the propagation in free space, Optics Express 17, 17888-17894 (2009)
records.quote: we derive the sufficient condition for Gaussian Schell-model (GSM) beam to keep the SOP unchanged
records.scope: Abstract states equal delta_xx, delta_yy, delta_xy and sigma_x=sigma_y.

records.source: Olga Korotkova, Sufficient condition for polarization invariance of beams generated by quasi-homogeneous sources, Optics Letters 36, 3768-3770 (2011)
records.access: Primary publisher abstract read; formula not inspected
records.quote: Conditions for invariance of the degree and the state of polarization of beams radiated by electromagnetic quasi-homogeneous sources into the far-zone are derived.
records.scope: Far-zone quasi-homogeneous source class, Bessel-correlated example.

records.source: Rosario Martínez-Herrero et al., A class of vectorial pseudo-Schell model sources with structured coherence and polarization, Optics & Laser Technology 152, 108079 (2022)
records.access: Full primary article read through institutional repository
records.quote: the same transverse patterns of either the state and the degree of polarization are obtained at any z-plane
records.scope: Section 5, Eq. 33. A common radial propagation factor multiplies the unchanged angular matrix. Nonuniform degree patterns are allowed; paraxial free space.

records.source: Jiajie Wu et al., Performance Analysis of Space-to-Ground Downlink for Polarization Shift Keying Optical Communications with a Gaussian-Schell Model Beam, Photonics 12, 643 (2025)
records.quote: The conditions depend on the source parameters and are unrelated to the turbulence parameters, modeled by the extended Huygens–Fresnel integral.
records.scope: Page 6, following Eq. 20; circular GSM source, equal correlation lengths, scalar isotropic downlink model. Not arbitrary vector/random media.

records.source: Zhiwei Tao et al., Atmospheric turbulence does not change the degree of polarization of vector beams (2023)
records.quote: all of the aforementioned conclusions are obtained through the coherence theory of light
records.scope: Abstract reports computed DOP changes around 10^-13 to 10^-6, almost negligible; this is not exact universal invariance.

records.source: Mary Beth Ruskai, Stanislaw Szarek and Elisabeth Werner, An analysis of completely-positive trace-preserving maps on M2, Linear Algebra and its Applications 347, 159-187 (2002)
records.scope: Section 1.2, Eqs. 2-5, establishes affine Bloch representation, rotation/unitary correspondence and transpose reflection; no novelty claim for using this machinery.
